description: This file defines the interface 'FieldDefinitionInterface' for entity field definitions in Drupal, including method signatures and documentation for managing field properties, configurations, and behaviors.

classes.name: FieldDefinitionInterface
classes.description: An interface for entity field definitions in Drupal, extending list data and cacheable dependency interfaces, providing methods to access field metadata, configuration, and default values.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the machine name of the field.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity type the field is attached to.

methods.name: getTargetBundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle the field is attached to, or NULL if not bundle-specific.

methods.name: isDisplayConfigurable
methods.description: Checks if the display for the field can be configured in a given context ('view' or 'form').

methods.name: getDisplayOptions
methods.description: Retrieves default display options for the field in a specified context.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Indicates if the field is required (non-empty).

methods.name: getDefaultValueLiteral
methods.description: Gets the raw default value as a literal array.

methods.name: getDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Gets the callback function for default value, if any.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Computes the default value for the field in a specific entity.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Indicates if the field is translatable.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Returns the storage definition object for the field.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Provides a configuration object for the field, optionally for a specific bundle.

methods.name: getUniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the field.
